::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2014 by Vijay Muktamath and Namit Varma (as Sensesemi Technologies). Raised ₹25 crore in January 2026 for tape-outs and reference-design work.
:::

## What does this firm design?

SenseSoC integrates AI inferencing, wireless mesh connectivity, precision analog front-end, an MCU, and security into a single chip, targeting wearables and connected medical devices.
